description: This file defines a template class 'ParserType' for parsing text streams with various states and options, along with classes 'TextParser' and 'PathParser' for text and path parsing respectively. It includes external headers related to enumeration, key-value pairs, numbers, optionals, portability, and ranges, indicating its role in a larger parsing framework within the 'WPEFramework::Core' namespace.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing streams of text with configurable terminators and handlers, managing internal states for whitespace, quotes, escape sequences, and more.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text fragments, providing methods to read text, numbers, enumerations, key-value pairs, and ranges, with support for skipping and validation.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing filesystem paths into drive, path, filename, basename, and extension components.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text from a TextFragment until delimiters are encountered.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of characters or positions.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds specified characters within the text.

methods.name: SkipLine
methods.description: Skips to the end of the current line.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the current text fragment against a comparison, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: ReadNumber
methods.description: Reads a number of a specified type from the text.

methods.name: ReadEnumerate
methods.description: Reads an enumeration value from the text.

methods.name: ReadKeyValuePair
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair from the text, separated by a specified divider.

methods.name: ReadRange
methods.description: Reads a range of numbers from the text.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a TextFragment into path components.
